about: The one list a shot is held to, by the director when planning, by the code before rendering and by the blind reviewer (user 2026-10-23: 怎么反复有问题 能不能做到没问题最优呢). Every item is measured by code where it can be (by: code, with the check that measures it) and judged by the reviewer only where it cannot (by: review). The reference itself passes every item at the same moment: an item the reference does not meet is not asked of us. A reviewer's fix names the item it fails (its id) and says how; no fix without an item. Kinds: the picture review's (layers.mjs PROBLEMS). Counts: the blind reviews' notes on hupo-auto2 that fall under the item before it was measured (133 shots, 16.8 versions each).

items.check: framecheck fills: at least half of what the reference carries at the moment
items.ask: 画面一样满：和对标同一时刻比，有内容的面积不少于对标的一半

items.check: framecheck balanceProblem: the lower half above the subtitle band carries its part where the reference's does
items.ask: 上下不头重脚轻：对标下半有东西时，我们的下半不空

items.check: framecheck firstFrameProblem: the first key frame carries a third of the reference's
items.ask: 第一张就有焦点：开头不是一行小字或空底

items.check: framecheck progressProblem at the sheet; breakdown compareBreakdown on the white model
items.ask: 三张看得出推进：对标在变的地方，我们也有东西一样样出来或镜头在走

items.check: framecheck: nothing cut by the frame at rest, every quarter second; 4 % margin
items.ask: 不出画：字和主体不被画框切，四边留边

items.check: framecheck: words over words (on one line 4 %), small type over a face, words hidden under a picture
items.ask: 不叠：字不压字、小字不压脸、字不被图盖住（大字压脸、压在产品后面可以）

items.check: framecheck: CJK 34 px, Latin 20 px, contrast 70, stand-off 60
items.ask: 读得清：字够大、够亮、和底分得开
字幕带（935 px 以下）空着

items.check: markErrors and phraseErrors: bars on whole words, at the line's height, on one line per cut
items.ask: 划线贴字：从词头到词尾、跟字一样高、不碰邻字

items.check: notSourceErrors, pageClaimError, STOCK_MARK: a formal source, the claim on the page, the story's dates, no watermark
items.ask: 来源正式：报道本身或官方，页面上就有口播那句话，时间对得上，没有图库水印

items.check: likeness.py showsErrors on the white model helps
items.ask: 画面是这一拍说的人、物、事（不是同类别的别的东西）
一个焦点、三档主次：最大的那样东西是主角，其余小一档淡一档

items.check: camera.js lens (from the reference's own depth, modules.mjs refLens); film.mjs flat shots
items.ask: 有层次不像幻灯片：底、主体、字分得开，有质感（虚化、光、颗粒），不是平涂色块排字

items.check: shotplan withRefDesign sets the reference's treatment from the card (metal, extrude, glow); modules.mjs TREATS
items.ask: 字有做工：对标这一刻的大字有处理（金属/做旧、立体厚度、斜体压色条、发光色散、粗黑体）时，我们的大字也有同类处理，不是一种干净宋体规规矩矩居中

items.check: depth.py flat shots in the film report; frame tilt/depth; passageCarry header/carry
items.ask: 版面有空间：对标是斜放的纸、互相压着的卡片、跨镜头留着的标签或叠化过去的标题时，我们不是一张正对镜头的平图、每镜各管各
同一档：上面各项都过了，整体讲究程度和对标同一时刻一样；版式、手法、配色不同不算
